content: 1. Glycemic status should be assessed using A1C levels and/or continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) metrics at least twice a year for individuals who have achieved their glycemic targets. For those who have not met their glycemic targets or experience frequent episodes of hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia, glycemic status should be evaluated every three months. 2. For individuals whose treatment plans have recently been modified or who are not meeting their glycemic goals, glycemic status should be monitored quarterly or more frequently as clinically indicated.
